project_overview.audit_scope: Complete architectural review equivalent to 10+ year senior Android engineer

module_structure.app: Main application module with DI configuration
module_structure.pokemon:domain: Business logic, models, and use cases

critical_issues.title: Production HTTP Logging Vulnerability
critical_issues.description: HttpLoggingInterceptor hardcoded to BODY level for all builds, exposing sensitive data in production logs
critical_issues.impact: CRITICAL - Sensitive user data and API responses logged in production builds, potential GDPR/privacy violations
critical_issues.prevention_pattern: Always use BuildConfig.DEBUG checks for production-sensitive configurations

critical_issues.title: Missing Production Migration Strategy
critical_issues.description: Room database uses fallbackToDestructiveMigration() without build-aware configuration
critical_issues.impact: CRITICAL - Data loss during production app updates when schema changes occur
critical_issues.prevention_pattern: Always plan proper migrations for production while allowing destructive migration in debug builds

critical_issues.title: Missing ViewModel Module Dependency
critical_issues.description: App module doesn't include :features:pokemon:viewmodel dependency, causing potential runtime failures
critical_issues.impact: CRITICAL - ViewModels won't be available at runtime, causing app crashes

recommended_fix.description: Add viewmodel module dependency to app module

critical_issues.prevention_pattern: Always include view module dependencies in app module build.gradle.kts

major_issues.title: Room Entity in Wrong Layer
major_issues.description: PokemonEntity with @Entity annotation is in datasource layer instead of database layer
major_issues.impact: MAJOR - Violates Clean Architecture principles, tight coupling between data source and persistence framework

recommended_fix.description: Move @Entity to database layer, keep DTOs clean in datasource
recommended_fix.code_example: Create PokemonEntity in database module, keep PokemonDbDto without @Entity in datasource

major_issues.prevention_pattern: Keep Room entities in database module, data source DTOs should be framework-agnostic

major_issues.title: Silent Error Handling Anti-Pattern
major_issues.description: Exception caught and ignored in refreshPokemonList without proper logging or user feedback
major_issues.impact: MAJOR - Network errors are silently ignored, users get no feedback about failed refresh attempts

recommended_fix.description: Implement proper error logging and propagation

major_issues.prevention_pattern: Always log errors and consider propagating them for proper user feedback

major_issues.title: N+1 Query Problem
major_issues.description: Sequential API calls for each Pokemon in the list instead of batch processing
major_issues.impact: MAJOR - Poor performance on slow connections, excessive API calls, potential rate limiting issues

recommended_fix.description: Consider batch processing or optimize API call patterns
recommended_fix.code_example: Implement caching strategy or use Pokemon list endpoint with more details

major_issues.prevention_pattern: Optimize API call patterns to avoid sequential requests for list operations

major_issues.title: Inconsistent Use Case Method Exposure
major_issues.description: RefreshPokemonListUseCase could violate SRP if additional methods are added
major_issues.current_code: suspend operator fun invoke(limit: Int = 20, offset: Int = 0)
major_issues.impact: MAJOR - Risk of violating Single Responsibility Principle if refresh logic becomes complex

recommended_fix.description: Keep use cases focused on single operations, create separate use cases for different refresh strategies
recommended_fix.code_example: Consider separate use cases for different refresh patterns if complexity grows

major_issues.prevention_pattern: Maintain single responsibility per use case, don't add multiple methods to same use case class

minor_issues.title: Potential Package Name Inconsistency
minor_issues.description: Project uses com.example.deepseekpokeappeleven but build-logic has com.example.starterdemo references
minor_issues.impact: MINOR - Potential confusion in package naming, but not build-breaking

recommended_fix.description: Ensure consistent package naming throughout project
recommended_fix.code_example: Update build-logic packages to match main project package

minor_issues.prevention_pattern: Use consistent package naming throughout all modules and build logic

minor_issues.title: Hardcoded Colors for Pokemon Types
minor_issues.description: Pokemon type colors are hardcoded in composable instead of being themeable
minor_issues.current_code: getPokemonTypeColor function with hardcoded Color values
minor_issues.impact: MINOR - Colors don't adapt to theme changes, potential accessibility issues

recommended_fix.description: Move type colors to theme system or resources
recommended_fix.code_example: Define type colors in MaterialTheme or use color resources

minor_issues.prevention_pattern: Use theme-aware colors instead of hardcoded values for better accessibility
